task: Flip the switch on the wall.

calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task is an unconditional command, 'Flip the switch on the wall', so switch_toggled must happen; the single RespondedExistence(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) only makes a toggle owed if the siren ever rings, and in a setup without a siren it requires nothing (the machine has empty FINAL_STATES and the rule-only warning). Add a hard Existence(switch_toggled) so the toggle is required; the RespondedExistence clause does not trace to any sentence of the task and should be removed (if a siren-silencing requirement were intended, the task would say so).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands flipping the switch unconditionally, so a hard Existence(switch_toggled) is exactly right; the switch is a lone commanded step and no order or other clause is stated.
